title: Laundry Renovation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Demolish and remove existing laundry setup including two base cabinets, one wall-mounted trough, and all wall and floor tiles. Supply and install two point four linear metres of custom white melamine cabinetry comprising two 900mm base cabinets and one 600mm base cabinet with standard handles, and two 900mm overhead cabinets. Install a two point four metre by 600mm by thirty-eight millimetre laminate benchtop in 'Arctic White' finish. Supply and install a Clark Roundline 45L stainless steel laundry trough with a Phoenix Vivid Slimline pull-out mixer tap. Tile wall splashback area two point four metres wide by 600mm high (approximately two point five square metres) with 300x600mm white ceramic tiles. Tile floor area two point five metres by one point eight metres (approximately five point five square metres) with 300x300mm grey non-slip ceramic tiles. Rough-in new hot/cold water and waste points for trough and washing machine, connect all new fixtures. Install two new double GPOs and replace existing light fitting with a new LED oyster light. Minor plaster repair and paint touch-ups.
workingDetail: Laundry cabinetry (base and overhead), Benchtop (laminate or stone), Laundry trough and tapware, Wall and floor tiles
